args.sql:
SELECT 
    r.posval AS position,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.reckey) AS total_num,
    COUNT(i.intkey) AS total_clicks,
    (COUNT(i.intkey) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT r.reckey)) AS ctr
FROM 
    Recommendations r
LEFT JOIN 
    Interactions i ON r.reckey = i.reclink
GROUP BY 
    r.posval
ORDER BY 
    r.posval;
